errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis are sorted by their corresponding values in descending order, not in alphabetical order as stated. The first letters of the categories are Ф, П, О, М, Н, which is not an alphabetical sequence.

The bar for the category "менторска подкрепа" (mentor support) reaches a value of approximately 28%, which is visibly below the 30% grid line. Stating the value is "около 30%" (around 30%) is an overestimation.
